target_customer: Pharma partners and investors; the company develops its own neuro therapies, starting with epilepsy
problem: Disorders driven by dysfunctional neural circuits lack therapies, and translation from mouse to human is poor.
business_model: Therapeutics developer using an AI discovery platform and in-house in vivo lab (no revenue model stated)

founders.name: Gabriel Ocana Santero
education: University of Oxford, MSc Neuroscience and PhD Pharmacology (YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page cites research in Boston, Vienna and Stockholm and neuroAI work at the Gatsby Unit (UCL)

founders.name: Marko Tvrdic
founders.background_notes: iPSC, retinal and circadian neuroscience per YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Combines agentic discovery models, cross-species neural activity modeling and a wet lab, which is research-grade work for a team of nine.

defensibility.rationale: In-house mouse neural activity data and a lab pipeline are costly to replicate, but the company has no clinical assets reported.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found; one low-authority aggregator lists Recursion as a competitor, not a dated source.

market_need_then: Epilepsy and other circuit disorders have unmet need; no dated evidence from early 2025 was gathered beyond the company's own description.

identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific; the CEO publicises results via X threads and arXiv papers per press coverage

branding.brand_signature: October 2026 experiment in which an AI agent drove a mouse brain injection, covered by Wired
branding.community_and_virality: Press attention to the October 2026 AI agent mouse experiment (Wired and others)

brand_strength.rationale: Strong press pickup in late 2026 for the experiment, but the coverage concerns the science, not the name.

outcome_analysis: Exin Therapeutics is an active YC Winter 2025 company building an agentic neuro drug discovery platform with a lab in Manila. Its profile rose in October 2026 when an AI agent chose a gene therapy and drove a mouse brain injection, per press. Funding is only visible through aggregators, so the stage and strength of backing cannot be judged, and no outcome has occurred yet.
notes: Unverified funding: aggregators report a 500K pre-seed from Y Combinator and Comal Ventures (Jan 2025) and a profile site cites a Form D of about 2.16M from 28 investors (Feb 2026, Caplight total 3.16M); I could not open the Form D, so none is recorded as a round. A geo.sig.ai claim of a 25M Philippines lab investment is low quality and ignored. The YC page also lists a team member named Ivan without a surname, whom I did not list as co-founder. Press reports conflict on which Claude model ran the experiment. Competitor search returned nothing dated near the batch, so the list is empty. Company website fetch returned only a page title. Completeness pass: the 500K January 2025 round rests on VCBacked (Caplight shows an Accelerator entry with Y Combinator on the same date) and the Feb 2026 seed of about 2.16M rests on a single outlet (Healthcare Discovery, citing a Form D, not opened). Caplight also lists a seed dated 2025-05-20 with the amount locked, not recorded, and a 3.16M total, so the recorded rounds may be incomplete. Amounts are not summed.
